title: Apps for ChatGPT
description: Dictation and Voice Mode let you have a real conversation with ChatGPT— you talk, it talks back, and ideas flow naturally.

title: Organizational Knowledge
description: Company Knowledge allows ChatGPT to link directly with your existing tools like Gmail, Google Calendar, and even Google Drive.

title: Deep Research
description: Dictation and Voice Mode let you have a real conversation with ChatGPT— you talk, it talks back, and ideas flow naturally.

title: Advanced Voice Mode
description: Dictation and Voice Mode lets you have a real conversation with ChatGPT — you talk, it talks back, and ideas flow naturally in both directions.

title: Project Folders
description: Projects let you group all your related chats, files, and notes into one organized workspace on the left sidebar.

title: Create AI Assistants
description: Custom GPTs let you build your own version of ChatGPT that's tuned to your role, tone, and resources — no coding required.

title: Real-time Translations
description: ChatGPT isn't just for writing—it's also a powerful translation tool. Upload a file, paste text, or use it as a live translator while chatting in another language.

title: Workflow: Research Topic, Create Artifact, Email Team, Book APpointment
description: Workflow: Research Topic, Create Artifact, Email Team, Book APpointment
content:
1. Click the Add “+” button to the left of the message 

  1. Select or type in Google Calendar, Google Drive, Gmail, and Canva. If you see a reasoning option, select “medium” or “high.” (Make sure to include all (4) connects for this exercise) 

  1. Next, use the Add “+” button to upload the district logo attached to this email. 
  1. Next, copy and paste the following prompt:

“Look in my Google Drive and Gmail for resources related to WellStyles. Create a 5–7 slide presentation in Canva with Agua Fria colors and style, opening with a discussion question, followed by some informational slides and a closing. Explain the program, how employees can earn points, the potential $500 benefit-cost offset, and how to get started. Include an opening question, a practical “choose your path to 10,000 points” activity, and a clear closing action. Use the attached district logo to guide the presentation’s colors and visual style. Email the presentation to mriley@aguafria.org and create a calendar invitation for August 25 at 3pm for a one-hour meeting with him to go over the slides.”


  1. You will get several windows asking for permission or confirmation. Review and approve them as they appear.

Note: It will take several minutes for the agent to complete the tasks.

From a single prompt, ChatGPT will coordinate a series of tasks across your connected tools:

  1. Search Google Drive and Gmail for relevant WellStyles content.
  2. Use Canva to create the presentation.
  3. Use Gmail to email me the completed presentation.
  4. Use Google Calendar to create and send the meeting invitation.

Congratulations, you’ve completed your first agentic workflow!
author: Harry Potter
